items.source: Constructs a new instance of the PropertyValueConversionService initialized with the given, required CustomConversions for resolving the PropertyValueConversions used to convert PersistentProperty values during data access operations.
items.translation: 构建一个新的PropertyValueConversionService实例，该实例使用给定的、必需的CustomConversions进行初始化，用于解析在数据访问操作期间转换PersistentProperty值的PropertyValueConversions。

items.source: General purpose conversion framework to read objects from a data store abstraction and write it back.
items.translation: 通用转换框架，用于从数据存储抽象中读取对象并将其写回。
